About Me

I'm a Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate at Anurag University (Hyderabad, Telangana) with a strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, and relational databases. My academic work focuses on translating core algorithmic concepts—like HashMaps, Queues, and Priority Queues—into practical, persistent software systems.

Outside of coursework, I actively participate in hackathons such as InnoQuest, organize college technical events, and explore emerging generative AI workflows. I'm seeking a Software Engineer Internship where I can contribute to backend, database, or full-stack application development.
